profile.reading:
Csquare IAD4-A sits at 21561 Beaumeade Circle, Ashburn, Virginia 20147, one of two street addresses (21561 and 21571 Beaumeade Circle) Csquare's own spec sheet lists under its single "IAD4" campus heading. Csquare (formerly branded Centersquare, launched April 2024 by Brookfield Infrastructure to combine Cyxtera, acquired out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy for $775 million in a deal completed January 2024, and Evoque, AT&T's divested data center business under Brookfield since 2019) went public via IPO on NASDAQ in July 2026 at $21.00 per share. Csquare's SEC Form S-1 property table lists only one Virginia "IAD4_A" line item, 58,939 square feet sellable, 77.8 percent leased as of March 31, 2026, treating IAD4 as a single reportable leased asset despite the two street addresses on the public spec sheet; this profile assigns that SEC figure to this specific address while flagging that Csquare's SEC disclosure does not itself separately break out IAD4-A from IAD4-B. Csquare's public spec sheet states a campus-wide 57,927 square feet of raised floor, 35.8 megawatts of utility power, 16.8 megawatts of UPS capacity, and 20 megawatts of generator capacity, with standard cage density up to 300 watts per square foot, and SOC 1/2 Type II, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 PE High, and ISO 27001 certifications. Csquare does not name a power utility or year-opened date; Dominion Energy serves Loudoun County's Ashburn corridor, the largest concentration of data center capacity in the world, as a matter of public record.

Ashburn's Data Center Alley is the largest concentration of data center capacity in the world, and Csquare's IAD4 campus sits among dozens of competing hyperscale and colocation operators within a few miles. Csquare's SEC S-1 discloses 389 megawatts of total sellable power capacity across its full 64-facility, 21-market portfolio as of March 31, 2026, and separately discloses that the company's legal predecessor entity, BIF III US Aggregator (Delaware) LLC, was formed in May 2018 as a Brookfield Infrastructure Fund III vehicle, well before the 2024 Cyxtera and Evoque combination that produced the assets tracked across this dataset.

sources.title: Csquare, Inc. Form S-1 Registration Statement (IAD4 reported as single asset "IAD4_A")

profile.research_note: Sqft is the SEC S-1 line item named "IAD4_A" (58,939 sqft sellable, 77.8% leased), attributed to this row since its own SEC line-item name matches this building's "-A" suffix, though Csquare's public spec sheet groups both IAD4-A and IAD4-B addresses under one undifferentiated campus heading. Power figures (35.8MW utility, 16.8MW UPS, 20MW generator) are campus-wide only, so no capacity figure was attributed. Cage density "up to 300 watts/sqft" is a ceiling, not a typical figure.

reading.body:
This facility's individual capacity is not published. The operator's market page describes a combined Ashburn IAD4 facility with 35.8 MW of utility power and 57,927 square feet of raised floor, but whether IAD4-A represents one third of that capacity, a distinct building, or a recording artifact remains undetermined. If the combined figure applied equally across three nearby registry rows, IAD4-A would hold roughly 11.9 MW of IT load, which at 40 kW per rack would support approximately 300 racks of AI training hardware as a rough estimate. The actual distribution of power and floor space among the three mapped rows is not published.

Virginia hosts 326 mapped data center facilities, but only 23 have published capacity figures totaling 1,375 MW of utility power. This facility does not break into Virginia's published top 23 by individual specification, ranking 24th among facilities with any published figure in the state. As part of a potential larger IAD4 campus, it would still rank below the largest published Virginia facilities but would represent material infrastructure in Northern Virginia's Ashburn cluster, where several major hyperscale campuses operate.

Centersquare, now operating under the brand Csquare, operates a portfolio stated at more than 500 MW across 80 facilities in 15 North American markets. No certifications or specific tenant qualifications for this facility are published. The operator's current market presence and the facility's location in Ashburn place it within reach of major cloud infrastructure demand, but without published capacity or power figures for this specific row, its significance to AI scaling cannot be quantified from available sources.
